card.name: Linking words before clearance or removal
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "is", "be" or "to" that come right after a drug or cell name and just before a verb about being removed, excreted or lysed.

modes.label: Drug is excreted
modes.description: The word "is" after a drug name, ahead of how the body clears it.
modes.example: because metformin<< is>> substantially excreted by the kidney.

modes.label: Cells to be removed
modes.description: "to" or "be" before a verb saying cells are lysed or removed.
modes.example: making them more likely to<< be>> lysed or removed from the circulation

card.writes: It seems to push toward verbs of leaving or being removed, and away from escape and slip words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says a drug or cell gets cleared or removed.
